The `--no-content` flag performs a metadata-only scan, which is useful for quickly assessing project structure before delegating deeper analysis. It limits the scan to file paths, sizes, and types without reading file contents, making it faster and safer for initial reviews.

The `select-model` command previews the recommended Mistral model for a given task before executing it with `run`. This helps validate the model choice and estimated token usage without consuming quota, ensuring cost-effective delegation.

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs project-scan --path path/to/project --no-content --max-files 20 --output snapshot.json
```

```powershell
node ~/.codex/skills/mistral-subagent/scripts/mistral-subagent.mjs select-model --task "Audit this TypeScript project and propose patches"
```
